props.Caption: So it's information you want, eh?  Well you've come to the right man.  I can provide you with inside information on the race, but it won't be cheap.  What're you looking for?
Are you sure you want to retire from the betting scene?
You have not sponsored any quibbles.
Need a little money, do ya?  I can give you a loan.  Of course, there's interest -- 15%, so you'd better be able to pay up when the time comes.
